x: Highlight of the afternoon was a magnificent run by Pat Newell who got the bronze medal in the over 60's only just behind Bob Belmore. Pat beat a rather off-form Charlie Walker by over a minute, the first time that he had beaten his friend since rejoining Belgrave last Spring.

Bert won the VAC 5 mile road race in June, his first Championship win, and achieved the fifth fastest time in the South of England relay at Aldershot, faster than Bob Belmore and Derek Wood of Barnet.
A successful trip too, with Bob Treadwell winning the M40 race, silver medals for the Belgrave M60 team, and Bob Belmore a rival member of the winning Barnet squad.
On the first leg, Charlie Walker did his best to hang on to Bob Belmore who suprised everyone with a 24:00 leg after a summer of little racing.
Bob Belmore, Veterans and Barnet AC Left: Bob Belmore might be Barnet now but only a true Belgravian would pose in front of a sign like that.
Pat Newell had got Bels off to a great start with his fastest ever 60's leg in 23:57 nearly a minute ahead of Cambridge and two and a half minute clear of Bob Belmore of Barnet.
Laurie O'Hara is still knocking out fast times and on this occasion he removed no less than 40 seconds from Bob Belmore's VAC M60 record set in 1988.

Our old friend from Vets' AC, Bob Belmore, sitting halfway down the straight opposite the stand, was kept busy all weekend as wind-gauge operator - not just recording the gusts but hanging onto the gauge, his papers and everything else that seemed to want to end up blown against the fence at the end…
